So `usage_len = sizeof(info.usage)` where `info.usage` is `unsigned int usage` (4 bytes). And `af_len = sizeof(info.access_flags)` where `info.access_flags` is also `unsigned int` (4 bytes).

In `decode_bit_field`:
```c
u8 data[sizeof(unsigned int)];  // 4 bytes
...
if (outlen != sizeof(data))  // outlen = *len = usage_len = 4, sizeof(data) = 4 - OK
        return SC_ERROR_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL;

n = decode_bit_string(inbuf, inlen, data, sizeof(data), 1, strict);
```

`decode_bit_string` checks `if (outlen < octets_left) return SC_ERROR_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL;` where `outlen = 4`. So `octets_left <= 4`, `count <= 4`, `n <= 32`.

The loop `for (i = 0; i < n; i += 8)` reads `data[i/8]` for `i = 0, 8, 16, 24`, so `data[0]` through `data[3]` - within bounds.
